dd-01: Lord of the world, lord of Gauri, father of Gajanana, foe of Tripura, three-eyed, ash-limbed, spear in hand, giver of boons and fearlessness — Shankara, lord of people.
dd-02: Lord of Gauri, Uma’s husband, Pashupati, Bharga, trident-bearer, Hara, tiger-skin, sky-clad, Srikantha, moon-crest — protect me from want.
dd-03: I bow to Shankara, Shambhu, Ishana, bull-bannered, Ganga-bearer, Mahadeva, Shiva who burns want.
dd-04: Faults of hand and foot, speech, body, act, ear, eye, or mind — commanded or not — forgive them all, ocean of compassion, Mahadeva Shambhu.
dd-05: Who recites this hymn near Shiva is freed from all want and goes to Shiva-loka.
